source.described_commit_note: This packet describes the E1-B code commit 1789448 (web/). The packet files themselves are added in the following commit on the same branch/PR.
source.pull_request: opened from branch codex/e1-b-react-shell after this commit

input.fixture_or_scenario_id: checked-in-typed-mocks (healthy, loading, empty, failure, safe-stop, stale, terminal-failure) + live localhost health
input.sha256_reason: Fixtures are TypeScript modules validated at test time against the vendored JSON Schemas; per-file hashing is not meaningful. Vendored contract hashes are in web/contracts/provenance.json.

hardware.note: local developer workstation (macOS, arm64); not the W7900 GPU gate

software.backend_for_live_capture: E1-A FastAPI (fastapi 0.128.8, uvicorn) from commit 4960fa0, run on 127.0.0.1:8080

model_and_serving.note: E1-B is a frontend status shell; no model was loaded. Model identity is displayed from the health contract only. The real W7900/ROCm model-viability gate is Lane A / Issue #5.

measurements.live_health_status: ok (database ok, gpu_viability NOT_VERIFIED, inference_mode local_only)

failures: Initial live E2E failed with a cross-origin (CORS) fetch because the E1-A backend sets no CORS headers. Resolved by shipping a same-origin Vite `/api` dev/preview proxy so the browser never makes a cross-origin request and the backend stays loopback-only.
recovery: Same-origin proxy; live E2E re-run passed against the real backend.
unverified: Real W7900/ROCm model viability (Lane A / Issue #5) is out of E1-B scope.

Asset/progress/terminal-result LIVE endpoints are not yet served by the backend; live mode truthfully reports 'not_served' for those panels. Their live integration is verified only when Lane A ships those endpoints.
npm ci against a committed package-lock.json was not run here (dependencies installed via npm install during development).

artifacts.desc: Healthy mock: health, version/autosave, milestones, run progress (40%, 2/5 basis, no ETA), counts, routes
Safe-stop (PAUSED terminal) with last durable version + recovery action
MODEL_UNAVAILABLE terminal with safe message + retry flag; health degraded
Toolbar mock->live switch; truthful error/empty when backend absent
LIVE against real E1-A FastAPI: real health, asset/run reported as not_served (no fabrication)

known_risks: E1-A contract checkpoint (PR #7) is still draft/unmerged; contracts are vendored verbatim with sha256 provenance and merge order stays E1-A -> E1-B.
Live asset/progress endpoints pending; live mode shows a truthful not_served state until Lane A ships them.
E1-A ProgressEventV1 omits `percent_basis` that qa/scripts/check_progress_invariants.py (artifact mode) requires — a Lane A cross-lane note.
decision.rollback: Frontend rollback is the last green scaffold/contract version. Delete web/ to return to pre-E1-B main; no backend/schema was modified.

history.notes: First E1-B PR checkpoint packet. Update with the real commit SHA and set dirty_tree=false once the branch is committed.
